He explains his variation project, specimen-preparation constraints, native names and selection of adult specimens; the appended instructions are his own prospective protocol, not evidence of receipt.
record_reviews.date_assessment: Preserve the source title and XML bounds (1855-12-24 to 1855-12-24); the displayed date may be bracketed, broad, or minute-derived. Any future delivery, forecast, or inferred relationship remains separate from composition, receipt, and demonstrated reading.
record_reviews.attribution_assessment: Darwin is the surviving body voice; named correspondents, books, minutes, enclosures, and quoted reports are explicitly treated as reported or separate voices.
record_reviews.unmatched_reason: No new accepted edge: the source is a request, acknowledgement, institutional minute, or incoming witness without a uniquely identified source-complete counterpart in this packet. Topic, adjacency, editorial cross-reference, or a named correspondent alone is insufficient.
